the friendly crossfire of loose talk, to let down the barriers of which we heartily approve when we totter outside in the street. Let's not worry too much about health issues like alcohol-induced sickness and dying young. I am no pansy: I don’t want anything inflicted on me until I’m good and ready. But CAMRA reports that there will be 2,000 fewer pubs on Britain’s streets by the end of 2009.
